title: Green Line: a capacity-under-development instrument
description: A capacity-under-development instrument: the green line of the docxology line-set. It records what is deliberately still being learned — apprenticeships, skills not yet mastered — with marker/counter-signal staging, and reads declared growth records against a versioned registry. Observations phrased as certification or credential language are staged aside with a note, never scored. It measures what is still growing — never competence, mastery, or virtue. Code and prose are Apache-2.0 licensed. See LICENSE in the repository.

methods.name: Three-stage read: intake, tag-intersection matching, status projection
methods.description: Self-declared observations are normalized fail-closed, matched to growth records whose tags intersect the attempt's tags, then projected into present/missing/stale marker surfaces.
methods.evidence: Growth records whose tags intersect the attempt’s declared tags apply. An empty intersection is the outcome OUTSIDE_SCOPE, not an exception.

methods.name: Formal definitions of growth records, freshness windows and aggregation
methods.description: Defines growth records, cultivation attempts, freshness relative to a review date and window, a finding rule, and an aggregation rule over four statuses.
methods.evidence: Given a review date 𝑟and window 𝑤, an observation dated 𝑡is fresh if 𝑡≤𝑟and 𝑟−𝑡≤𝑤; stale if 𝑡≤𝑟and 𝑟−𝑡> 𝑤; not counted otherwise. Undated observations are fresh.

methods.name: Lexical counter-signal staging of certification/credential language
methods.description: Observations labeled with certification, credential or resume language are set aside with a note and not counted toward any marker surface.
methods.evidence: counter-signal labels (certification, credential, resume language) are staged aside with an explanatory note and never counted. Nothing crashes on hostile input and no value is invented.

methods.name: Canonical serialization pinned by SHA-256 digests (pure stdlib package)
methods.description: Each read is a pure function of attempt, registry and review config, serialized canonically and pinned by a SHA-256 digest of reading and registry.
methods.evidence: Reads are serialized canonically (sorted keys, declaration order preserved with explicit sorts before emit) and pinned by a SHA-256 digest of both the reading and the registry that produced it.

key_findings: A read returns one of four staged statuses describing marker coverage at a review date, explicitly not competence, mastery or permission.
In the worked example, one applied record reads STAGED and the rest NEEDS_MARKER, so the overall status is NEEDS_MARKER.
Adding a 'certified as expert' observation leaves the read unchanged because certification language is staged aside rather than scored.
The author states the limit that a read describes marker declarations, not verified practice or skill growth.
The author notes counter-signal detection is lexical, so an innocently phrased resume-shaped record passes intake.
key_findings_evidence: A read returns staged statuses (STAGED, NEEDS_MARKER, NEEDS_REWORK, OUTSIDE_SCOPE) that describe marker coverage at a review date and never competence, mastery, or permission.
The overall status is NEEDS_MARKER: gaps ask for practice, not judgment.
the read is unchanged, because certification language is exactly the drift the line refuses to score.
A read describes marker declarations, not practice: a declared marker is not verified evidence that a mentor met, a drill ran, or a skill grew.
Counter-signal detection is lexical; a resume-shaped growth record phrased innocently passes intake. The instrument surfaces vocabulary drift, not intent.
